newsitem.title: CANADA: Hollinger nearer control of Southam.
newsitem.headline: Hollinger nearer control of Southam.

text.p: Hollinger Inc chairman Conrad Black said on Friday he is closer to gaining a majority stake in Canada's largest-circulation newspaper group, Southam Inc.
"Yes (we are getting close to taking control). Closer in time," Black said in a telephone interview.
"I don't expect to be the source of a bonanza in the stock price, but our intention has not changed," he added.

Hollinger has gained effective control of Southam with a 41 percent stake in the company, but Black has maintained that he would like to have a more than 50-percent holding so he can consolidate its results.
